snippet.title: OrbitFix - Demo Trailer
snippet.description: Inherit a derelict space station on the edge of the galaxy and breathe new life into it. As the ultimate space mechanic, you will repair diverse spaceships, trade with pilots, and expand your services. Start with a single rusty dock and build the most bustling service hub in the sector!
